question: Which part of the Indian Constitution deals with the organisation, composition and powers of state legislature?
solution: The Correct answer is __**Part VI**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Part VI** is titled **“The States".** • The organization, composition, and powers of state legislature in India are addressed in Part VI of the Indian Constitution. • This part specifically outlines the **structure, functioning, and authority of the legislative bodies **at the state level. • Part VI ensures that each state has its own legislative body, which plays a vital role in state **governance and policymaking**.
